title: [LOGGED IN] Logged-in Referral panel shows the referral link and no rewards

steps.text: If a cookie banner is shown, click Dismiss. If a Login successful popup is shown, click Ok.
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss. No Login successful popup.

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button, balances 0 and 40, no Login button

steps.text: Click the white "Referral program" button at the bottom right.
steps.saw: Panel 'Invite friends - get bonuses together!' opened on the right

steps.text: Does the panel show a field with a link that starts with "https://site.ludus-game.com/?referralCode=" and a green "Copy" button?
steps.saw: Field value https://site.ludus-game.com/?referralCode=... (shown cut as 'https://site.ludus-game.com/?referr...'), green Copy button

steps.text: Does the panel show "No rewards to claim yet"?
Is a "Back to store" button shown?
Is there no "Log in to view rewards" button?
steps.saw: No such button in the panel

steps.text: Click the round X button at the bottom right.
steps.saw: Clicked the round X button (same toggle as Referral program button)
Panel closed; Referral program button back at bottom right
